title: Preparing S12 Cell Extracts Using Bead-Beater
author: Anibal Arce Medina
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ieacbae
materials: Prepare all the needed solutions and materials needed including 2XYT+P media and S30B buffer. 2XYT+P media: Put 62 g 2xYT, into a 3-liter recipient. Add 80 ml of 1M potassium phosphate dibasic solution, and 44 ml of 1M potassium phosphate monobasic solution. Fill with water to 2 Liters. Dissolve and mix well. Aliquot in 1-liter bottles. Autoclave. S30B : Put 5.44 g of Mg-glutamate and 12.195 g K-glutamate into a 1-liter bottle. Add 800 ml of water and adjust pH to 8.2 using 2M Tris. Finally, fill with water to 1 liter. Autoclave, store at 4 °C. add 1 ml 1 M DTT just before use. Be sure to have all the things needed in this protocol including the bead beater, 0.1mm diameter beads, 5ml pipet and tips, chromatography columns, autoclaved bead-beater tubes and autoclaved 500ml centrifuges bottles. 2XYT Broth Contributed by users Catalog #3012-032 K-glutamate Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #G1149 Mg-glutamate Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #49605 Potassium phosphate dibasic solution Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #P8584 Potassium phosphate monobasic solution Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #P8709 Micro Bio-Spin Chromatography Columns Contributed by users Catalog #732-6204 Beads, 0.1mm dia. Contributed by users Catalog #11079101 Bead-beating tubes (polypropylene microvials) Contributed by users Catalog #522S

steps.title: Prepare Mini-culture 1
steps.instruction: Inoculate a bacterial culture tube containing 5mL of 2XYT+P media with a glycerol stock of BL21 DE3 STAR. Grow overnight at 37°C with agitation.

steps.title: Prepare Mini-culture 2
steps.instruction: Inoculate 50 mL of 2xYT + P culture medium in a 500mL Erlenmeyer flask with 300 μL of mini-culture 1. Grow for 12 hours at 37°C with agitation.

steps.title: Prepare Collection Tube
steps.instruction: Weigh an empty sterile 50 ml Falcon tube, record its mass, and chill it on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Main Cultures
steps.instruction: Pour 330 mL of 2xYT + P culture medium into four 2L Erlenmeyer flasks and preheat at 37ºC for 30 min.

steps.title: Inoculate and Induce Cultures
steps.instruction: Inoculate each 2L flask with 11mL (~3% final volume) of mini-culture 2 and grow at 37°C with agitation.

substeps.instruction: Check OD after 1h 30m.
When OD reaches ~0.6, add 350 μL of 1M IPTG to each flask.
Continue growth at 37°C with agitation until OD reaches ~1.5-2.0 (typically another 1h 30m after IPTG addition). Total process should not exceed 3h 45m.

steps.title: Harvest Bacterial Cells
steps.instruction: Transfer bacterial cultures evenly into 500mL centrifuge bottles and centrifuge at 5000 x g for 12 min at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Completely remove supernatant by decanting and blotting bottles on paper towels.
Keep pellets and bottles on ice (or store at 4 ºC overnight).

steps.title: Prepare S30B Buffer with DTT
steps.instruction: Complete the S30B buffer by adding 1 ml of 1 M DTT to 1L of previously prepared S30B. Mix and maintain on ice.

steps.title: Wash Bacterial Pellets
steps.instruction: Wash the pellets using chilled S30B buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 mL of chilled S30B buffer to each of the four centrifuge bottles and shake vigorously until pellets are completely solubilized.
Centrifuge at 5,000 g for 12 min at 4 °C.
Remove supernatant by decanting and blotting.
Repeat this wash step one more time.

steps.title: Final Pellet Recovery
steps.instruction: Resuspend pellets in S30B buffer containing DTT and concentrate.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 ml S30B (with DTT) buffer at 4 °C to each centrifuge bottle.
Transfer the dissolved pellets into the chilled, pre-weighted 50 ml Falcon tube.
Centrifuge the Falcon tube at 2,000g for 8 minutes at 4°C.
Remove supernatant by decanting and blotting.
Re-centrifuge the Falcon tube at 2,000 g for 2 min at 4 °C.
Completely remove residual supernatant by pipette and keep on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Bead-Cell Mixture
steps.instruction: Calculate required S30B (with DTT) and bead mass based on the pellet mass of the 50ml Falcon tube, then mix.

substeps.instruction: Add the calculated amount of S30B buffer and vortex to resuspend cells.
Add beads in three separate loads (1/3 of total beads each time), vortexing to mix and keeping on ice for 30 seconds between loads.
Vortex after the final load to ensure a uniform thick paste.

steps.title: Prepare Modified Pipette
steps.instruction: Cut the end of a 5 ml pipette tip with a sterile razor blade to create a 3-4 mm opening and dial the pipette to 2 ml.

steps.title: Load Bead-Beating Tubes
steps.instruction: Transfer the bead-cell solution into 5 autoclaved bead-beating tubes on ice using the modified pipette.

substeps.instruction: Verify the solution is viscous enough to barely exit the pipette tip.
Fill each tube three-quarters full.
Spin each tube briefly (1s) on a counter mini-centrifuge to remove air bubbles.
Form a concave meniscus in the tube.
Place a very small drop of solution onto the inside of the cap (avoiding the outside lip).
Tightly seal the cap, ensuring no air bubbles are visible.
Vortex the main Falcon tube frequently during this process to maintain bead distribution.

steps.title: Perform Bead Beating
steps.instruction: Process the tubes in pairs with an assistant.

substeps.instruction: Keep filled tubes on ice for at least one minute before beating.
Beat one tube for 30 sec at 46 rpm.
Place the beaten tube upside down on ice for 30 sec while beating the second tube for 30 sec.
Repeat the process so each tube is beaten for a total of 1 min.

steps.title: Extract Recovery
steps.instruction: Filter the processed mixture using a custom apparatus and centrifuge.

substeps.instruction: Construct a filter: Place a bead-beating cap (flat-part up) at the bottom of a 15 ml Falcon tube.
Press a micro-chromatography column firmly onto the end of the processed bead-beating tube, snap off the elution end, and place the column (elution end down) into the bead-beating tube.
Place this assembly into the 15 mL Falcon tube.
Centrifuge the uncapped 15 mL Falcon tube at 6,000 g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Discard any turbid extracts.
Transfer supernatant from non-turbid tubes (where the pellet has two distinct layers) into 1.75 ml micro-centrifuge tubes, avoiding the pellet.
Store extracts at -80°C.
